title: One visitor's press and purchase are counted once, however many times the page, the pixel and the business's server report them

milestones.title: The same visitor viewing twice in an hour is one view
Pressing twice within a minute is one press, with one click id
The thank-you page's pixel reports the purchase (unverified)
The business's server reports the same order: it replaces the pixel's, now verified
The same order reported again is a duplicate
The pixel firing again after the postback changes nothing
The owner's figures count one press, one purchase and its revenue once
